title: Generated application cron configuration
description: Runtime sc-config fragment for schedule rows. This is not a generation option. Generation answers stay the four keys in wizard/answers.schema.json. cargo-generate excludes this file so a generated project does not contain answers.schema.json. The daemon reads cron.max_schedule_rows from config/default.json. No layout opens the scheduler yet; the layout that does passes CronConfig::row_limit into sc_cron::ScheduleLimits.

max_schedule_rows.description: Maximum schedule rows, enabled and disabled. 0 means unlimited.
